players.product: Firefly / Acrobat AI Assistant / GenStudio AI creative and marketing applications

quarterly_data.signal: CFO: Q1 FY2026 revenue of $6.40 billion, growing 12% year-over-year as reported and 11% in constant currency; non-GAAP EPS $6.06 (up 19%); non-GAAP operating margin 47.4%. Business Professionals & Consumers subscription revenue $1.78 billion; Creative & Marketing Professionals subscription revenue $4.39 billion.
quarterly_data.figure: Revenue $6.40 billion, +12% YoY as reported (11% constant currency); non-GAAP EPS $6.06; non-GAAP operating margin 47.4%; BP&C subscription revenue $1.78 billion; C&MP subscription revenue $4.39 billion

quarterly_data.signal: CFO: total Adobe ending ARR of $26.06 billion, growing 10.9% year-over-year; RPO of $22.22 billion exiting the quarter, growing 13% year-over-year; cRPO growing 12% as reported. Management said the freemium offerings have a near-term impact on ARR but expects growth to start to accelerate in the back half.
quarterly_data.figure: Ending ARR $26.06 billion, +10.9% YoY; RPO $22.22 billion, +13% YoY; cRPO +12%

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 FY2026 targets given on the call (excluding Semrush, which Adobe continues to expect to close in Q2 subject to regulatory approvals): total revenue $6.43 billion to $6.48 billion, BP&C subscription revenue $1.80 billion to $1.82 billion, C&MP subscription revenue $4.41 billion to $4.44 billion, non-GAAP EPS $5.80 to $5.85, non-GAAP operating margin approximately 44.5%; FY26 targets reaffirmed, including total Adobe ARR growth of 10.2%.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 FY2026 revenue target $6.43 billion to $6.48 billion; non-GAAP EPS $5.80 to $5.85; non-GAAP operating margin approximately 44.5%; FY26 ARR growth 10.2% reaffirmed

quarterly_data.signal: AI monetization: ARR from AI-first applications more than tripled year-over-year; Firefly ending ARR across Firefly app, Firefly credit packs and Firefly Enterprise exceeded $250 million; Firefly subscription and credit pack ending ARR grew 75% quarter-over-quarter; generative credit consumption grew over 45% quarter-over-quarter, skewing to video (video generative actions growing more than 8x year-over-year) and audio. CEO said the AI-first book of business 'should be our next billion-dollar business'.
quarterly_data.figure: AI-first ARR more than tripled YoY; Firefly ending ARR exceeded $250 million; Firefly subscription and credit pack ARR +75% QoQ; generative credit consumption +45% QoQ; video generative actions more than 8x YoY

quarterly_data.signal: User acquisition: surpassed 850 million monthly active users of Acrobat, Creative Cloud, Express and Firefly, 17% year-over-year growth; creative freemium MAU crossed 80 million, growing 50% year-over-year; AI Assistant MAU doubled and Express MAU tripled year-over-year; Acrobat AI Assistant ARR grew approximately 3x year-over-year.
quarterly_data.figure: 850 million MAU, +17% YoY; creative freemium MAU crossed 80 million, +50% YoY; Acrobat AI Assistant ARR approximately 3x YoY

quarterly_data.signal: Enterprise momentum: GenStudio and AEP and apps ending ARR each grew over 30% year-over-year; customers with ARR over $10 million grew greater than 20% year-over-year; over 650 customer trials underway for LLM Optimizer, Sites Optimizer and Brand Concierge; 70% of all AEP customers using the agentic capabilities; over 2,500 custom models since launch for Firefly Services; Firefly Enterprise new customer acquisition grew 50% year-over-year.
quarterly_data.figure: GenStudio and AEP and apps ending ARR each grew over 30% YoY; customers with ARR over $10 million grew greater than 20% YoY; over 650 agentic-web trials; over 2,500 custom models; Firefly Enterprise new customers +50% YoY

quarterly_data.signal: Headwind: traditional stand-alone stock business declined faster than expected as customers shift to generative AI; CEO sized it at about a $450 million book of business and said that excluding stock, ARR growth would have been approximately 11.2% instead of 10.9%.
quarterly_data.figure: Stock business about a $450 million book of business; ex-stock ARR growth approximately 11.2% vs 10.9%

quarterly_data.signal: Distribution on AI platforms: launched Acrobat and Express for ChatGPT in Q1, with similar integrations expected into Copilot, Claude and Gemini; Firefly users can generate with over 30 industry-leading models including Adobe, Google and OpenAI; GenStudio assets now flow into ad platforms including Amazon Ads, Google, LinkedIn and Meta. CEO calls the Google partnership around Nano Banana 'a great partnership'.

Leadership transition: Shantanu Narayen announced he will transition from the CEO role after over 18 years, staying on as Chair; he expects the Board's successor search to take a few months. Next catalysts named: Semrush acquisition expected to close in Q2 and Adobe Summit in April.

connects_to.relationship: Cloud services and Nano Banana model for Adobe applications

contracts.signal: Adobe CEO: "if you look at the larger companies like Google, we're actually with them and with Nano Banana, it's been a great partnership because we are providing them with a lot of customers and they're providing us with great technology."
